verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a PPT assistant with template selection and smart layout, and an Agent that builds web pages with multi-round modification, deployment and sharing. Kimi Code's agent can also edit local files through conversation. These are only help-center topic titles, though, and nothing shows general document creation, iterative editing of presentations, or file export. missing for 10: explicit document (e.g., Word/PDF) creation, documented iterative editing of decks/documents, documented export formats and download, in-depth first-party docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export
